title: Cosmic Surreal Face
description: A large surreal spherical face divided into colorful segments dominates a balcony terrace at sunset. The face features one large realistic eye, a winking eye, a mustache, and lips, surrounded by a glowing spiral galaxy, a full moon, a crescent moon, and geometric star shapes.
prompt: Surreal spherical face divided into colored segments floating above a Mediterranean balcony terrace at sunset. The face has one large open realistic eye on purple section, a winking eye on yellow section, black mustache and lips. A glowing spiral galaxy appears on the left, full moon above, crescent moon and geometric orange stars in the background. Italian-style buildings with flower pots on both sides, dramatic twilight sky with stars and distant hills, vibrant painterly style.
